independent_proof_check.B_min: Per-job minimum eligible endpoint assignment is feasible and OPT<=B_min<=sum_j min_i p_ij<=nOPT; empty/ineligible/B_min=0 handled first.
independent_proof_check.rounding_and_cap: epsilon0=min(epsilon,1); q=epsilon0 B_min/n^2>0; a=ceil(p/q); original optimum has rounded load <=OPT/q+n <=K=floor(n^2/epsilon0+n). A scaled optimum therefore exists below K.
independent_proof_check.safe_pruning: Every processed load is a nonnegative sub-sum of a complete feasible load, including joins; a single a_ij>K can be skipped without removing the retained witness.
independent_proof_check.exact_DP: L<=K+1 includes zero. Nice incidence states store per-job 0/1 selected-edge flag and per-machine integer load. Unique edge-introduction, forget-job=1, join flag sum<=1 and load sum<=T give soundness/completeness. Backpointers recover n actual machine assignments.
independent_proof_check.fixed_width_decomposition: Enumerate small boundaries S and components C, normalize S=N(C), then enumerate first C-touching bag B. Connected union of C-containing bags and root-to-neighbor paths force S subset B. Recursion on smaller components D uses N(D) subset B, giving |V|^{O(k)} search. Dual machine cliques allow incidence width <=k+1.
independent_proof_check.bit_and_output_complexity: Compute ceil(n^2 v p/(u B_min)) by polynomial-bit integer arithmetic. DP arrays depend on K, not original processing-time magnitude. Fixed-k polynomial time in encoded input and 1/epsilon, including decomposition, feasibility binary search and output O(n log(m+1)) bits.
